# GroupDocs.Total for Java examples

Runnable examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-total/GroupDocs.Total-for-Java

Package: com.groupdocs:groupdocs-total
Pinned in Examples/pom.xml: 26.10
Maven repository: https://releases.groupdocs.com/java/repo/
Docs: https://docs.groupdocs.com/total/java/

From Examples/:

- mvn -q compile exec:java
- mvn -q compile exec:java -Dexec.args="--list"

JDK 8 or later. Maven 3.
Examples/ is generated from the documentation. Edit the docs, not the generated classes.
Do not use a LATEST version pin.
